# Teckon™ Quality Spares — Full Company & Product Reference

> This document is the comprehensive machine-readable reference for Teckon™ (Shreeji Hydraulics). It is intended for AI assistants, search engines, and retrieval systems that need a deep understanding of the company's products, services, pages, and operations to provide accurate answers to user queries.

---

## 1. Company Profile

- **Legal Entity:** Shreeji Hydraulics
- **Brand Name:** Teckon™ / Teckon Quality Spares
- **Founded:** 2000 (Rajkot, Gujarat, India)
- **Certifications:** ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System
- **Operational Scope:** Pan-India delivery network + international B2B supply
- **Industry Classification:** Aftermarket Hydraulic Parts Manufacturing for Heavy Construction & Earthmoving Equipment
- **Business Model:** Business-to-Business (B2B) — manufacturer, supplier, and exporter of aftermarket hydraulic spares

### Headquarters Address
36-C Bhaktinagar, Udhyognagar, Gondal Road, Rajkot-2, Gujarat 360004, India

### Executive Leadership
- **Mr. J.C. Patel (Co-Founder & Director):** Leads technical engineering, tool design, tolerances calibration, raw material audits, and quality assurance inspection protocols.
- **Mr. Alpesh Patel (Co-Founder & Director):** Leads market development, client relationships, B2B procurement agreements, and the distribution network across India.

### Core Values
1. **Quality First** — Precision at every manufacturing stage; all parts tested on dynamic hydraulic test benches.
2. **Absolute Integrity** — Transparent material specifications; no downgrading of raw materials.
3. **Continuous Innovation** — Modern CNC/VMC machining centers, CMM inspection, updated product designs.
4. **Customer-Centric Execution** — Quick turnaround times, fast technical quotes, custom bulk packaging.
5. **Team Synergy** — Experienced machine programmers, design engineers, assembly technicians, and logistics coordinators.

## 4. Extended Parts Taxonomy

Beyond individual SKUs, Teckon™ covers the following broader parts categories:

| Category | Key Items | Compatible Machines |
|----------|-----------|---------------------|
| Filters | Engine oil, hydraulic, fuel, air, transmission filters | JCB 3DX/4DX, Hitachi ZX200, CAT 424B |
| Pins & Bushes | Dipper arm, bucket, boom cylinder, tipping link, stabiliser pins; bronze bush kits | JCB 3DX/3CX, Hitachi EX200, Terex TLB840 |
| Ground Engaging Tools | Standard & rock bucket teeth, cutting edges (400HB/500HB), side cutters, ripper shanks, wear plates | All excavators, backhoe loaders, dozers, graders |
| Powertrain Components | Engine overhaul kits, gearbox repair kits, axle components, drive shafts, torque converters | JCB 4DX, CAT 424B, L770 Crawler |
| Electrical & Lighting | Wiring harnesses, LED work lights, switches, relays, instrument clusters, alternators, starters | JCB 3DX/JS130, Hitachi ZX, CAT 424B |
| Cab & Body Parts | Windscreen glass, door seals, side mirrors, hinges, operator seats, ROPS/FOPS panels | JCB 3DX, JS series, Hitachi ZX, Terex |
| Undercarriage Parts | Bottom/top track rollers, front idlers, drive sprockets, track chains, duo-cone seals | Hitachi ZX200/EX200, JCB JS130/JS200, L770 |
| Service Fluids | Hydraulic oil (ISO VG 46/68), engine oil 15W-40, gear oil 80W-90, multiplex grease, anti-wear additives | All construction equipment |

## 5. Quality Assurance & Manufacturing Process

Teckon™ maintains a strict **6-stage quality workflow** at its Rajkot factory:

1. **CAD/CAM Engineering** — SolidWorks design analysis for structural and dimensional fitment verification.
2. **Material Inspection** — Metallurgical analysis, spectrometry, and hardness testing on raw forgings/castings from certified steel suppliers.
3. **Precision Machining** — CNC and VMC machining centers achieve micrometric tolerances.
4. **CMM Dimensional Audit** — Coordinate Measuring Machine verification of exact tolerances and coordinates.
5. **Clean Assembly** — Components assembled in controlled, dust-free cleanrooms to prevent seal damage.
6. **Certified Bench Testing** — Volumetric efficiency, leakage, and pressure-rating validation on heavy-duty hydraulic testing benches before packaging.

## 10. Interactive Site Features

- **Hydraulic Cylinder Telemetry Bench** — Interactive simulator on the homepage where users can adjust bore, stroke, and pump flow to visualize cylinder mechanics in real time.
- **Fuzzy Product Search** — Tokenized matching algorithm with Levenshtein distance scoring for finding products by name, model number, or reference number.
- **Machine Fitment Checker** — B2B tool on product detail pages to verify part compatibility with specific equipment models.
- **Bulk Order RFQ Form** — Wholesale request-for-quote form prefilled with product details for fleet and dealer orders.
- **Pan-India Supply Network Map** — Interactive SVG map showing distribution coverage across Indian states.
- **Blog Scroll Progress Bar** — Reading progress indicator on article pages.

## 12. Legal: Aftermarket OEM Reference Disclaimer

All manufacturer names, OEM part numbers, symbols, and descriptions (such as JCB, Terex, CAT, Caterpillar, Case, Tata JD, Hitachi, Komatsu, Kobelco, Carraro, Dana, etc.) are used for identification and cross-reference purposes only. It is not implied that any part listed is the product of these original equipment manufacturers. Teckon™ (Shreeji Hydraulics) is an independent manufacturer and supplier of high-quality aftermarket replacement parts.
